result.stdout:
BidiLint — lint localization files for bidi (bidirectional text) pitfalls.

Usage: bidilint <path> [<path>...] [options]
       bidilint --init [--config <file>]

  <path>              Folder or file to lint. May be repeated.
  --base <culture>    Base culture other cultures are compared against (default: en).
  --format text|json  Output format. Defaults to text.
  --fail-on <level>   error (default), warning, or none.
  --strict            Alias for --fail-on warning.
  --max-warnings <n>  Fail when the warning count exceeds n.
  --quiet             Print only errors in text output.
  --color             Force color on a terminal.
  --no-color          Disable color; NO_COLOR is also honored.
  --config <file>     Use a specific bidilint.json.
  --no-config         Ignore config discovery and use defaults.
  --init              Write a documented bidilint.json starter file.
  --baseline <file>   Apply a baseline of accepted findings.
  --update-baseline   Rewrite the baseline from current findings.
  --no-baseline       Ignore a configured baseline.
  --debug             Print config details and full exceptions.
  --help              Show this help.
  --version           Show the version.

Formats: JSON, .resx, Android res/values XML, Apple .strings, gettext PO/POT, Flutter ARB.
Config: bidilint.json (JSONC), discovered upward from the target path.
Exit codes: 0 clean · 1 usage/config · 2 input/path · 3 no locale files or base missing ·
            4 findings · 5 internal error.
